sections.title: Atrium Health Academic AI (Post-Wake Forest Merger)
sections.description: Atrium Health (Charlotte HQ) — following its 2022 merger with Wake Forest University Health Sciences creating a 40+ hospital academic health system.

blocks.heading: Wake Forest Baptist academic research AI
paragraphs: ML for the clinical research programs newly integrated into Charlotte through Atrium's Wake Forest partnership — oncology clinical trials, cardiovascular research, and the biomedical AI programs that Wake Forest's NCI-designated Cancer Center brings to Charlotte's health system.

blocks.heading: Atrium population health at scale
paragraphs: ML for Atrium's large Carolinas and Southeast patient population — population risk stratification, readmission prediction, and care gap analytics for 40+ hospitals and 1,400+ access points across North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, and Alabama.

blocks.heading: North Carolina Medicaid and NC Health Choice
paragraphs: ML for the managed care organizations serving North Carolina's 3 million+ Medicaid beneficiaries — Atrium's managed care relationships with NCDHHS create specific population health analytics requirements for North Carolina's Medicaid expansion population.

sections.title: Novant Health Clinical AI
sections.description: Novant Health (Winston-Salem HQ with major Charlotte operations) — 15+ hospitals across North Carolina and Virginia.

blocks.heading: Epic-integrated clinical prediction
paragraphs: ML for Novant's large Epic-deployed patient population — sepsis early warning, fall risk prediction, and care gap identification embedded in Novant's Epic clinical workflow for the health system's hospital and ambulatory networks.

blocks.heading: Charlotte community health analytics
paragraphs: ML for the specific health needs of Charlotte's diverse and rapidly growing population — Charlotte's extraordinary demographic diversity (significant Southeast Asian, Hispanic, and African American communities) creates health analytics requirements calibrated to Charlotte's specific demographic mix.

sections.title: Teladoc Health Digital Analytics
sections.description: Teladoc Health (major Charlotte operations) — the world's largest virtual care company.

blocks.heading: Virtual care utilization prediction
paragraphs: ML for Teladoc's large virtual care platform — predicting which patients and health plan members will engage with virtual care vs. in-person care, enabling payers and employers to target virtual care promotion to the members most likely to adopt it.

blocks.heading: Telehealth outcome analytics
paragraphs: ML for measuring and predicting the clinical outcomes of Teladoc's large-scale virtual care programs — demonstrating the clinical effectiveness of telemedicine for the payer negotiations and regulatory advocacy that Teladoc conducts for expanded coverage.

sections.title: Charlotte Managed Care and Health Plan AI
sections.description: For Humana's Charlotte operations and the health plans serving the North Carolina market.

blocks.heading: NC Medicaid managed care analytics
paragraphs: ML for the MCOs participating in North Carolina's Tailored Plans (behavioral health Medicaid) and Standard Plans (physical health Medicaid) — Atrium's and Novant's managed care relationships create analytics opportunities for the health plans managing North Carolina's newly reformed Medicaid system.

blocks.heading: Medicare Advantage quality analytics
paragraphs: ML for the health plan quality analytics supporting the CMS Star ratings that determine Medicare Advantage bonuses for the plans serving Charlotte's large and growing retiree population.

sections.title: North Carolina healthcare AI regulatory context
sections.description: Key regulatory considerations for healthcare AI development in North Carolina.

blocks.heading: North Carolina HIPAA and state health privacy
paragraphs: North Carolina's health privacy protections align primarily with federal HIPAA rather than adding state-specific requirements beyond HIPAA, creating a relatively clean regulatory environment compared to states like New York and Washington.

blocks.heading: North Carolina Medicaid reform
paragraphs: North Carolina's Medicaid managed care program, launched in 2022, creates specific MCO analytics requirements for the health plans participating in the reform — population health outcome measurement, network adequacy analytics, and value-based payment performance analytics.

sections.title: Charlotte's healthcare AI transformation
sections.description: Charlotte's healthcare AI market is undergoing a step-change transformation driven by several converging developments.

blocks.heading: Atrium's Wake Forest merger as academic catalyst
paragraphs: The Atrium-Wake Forest merger that created Advocate Health fundamentally changed Charlotte's healthcare AI ambition — from a capable community health system to the country's fifth-largest not-for-profit health system with an academic medical center mission. The Wake Forest School of Medicine's research programs, the NCI cancer center, and the academic clinical research culture that Wake Forest brings to Charlotte create healthcare AI demand that Charlotte's health systems could not have generated independently.

blocks.heading: Charlotte's explosive population growth
paragraphs: Charlotte has been one of the US's fastest-growing major metros for a decade — Mecklenburg County has grown from 800,000 to nearly 1.2 million residents in a decade, and the surrounding region's growth has been proportionally significant. The healthcare capacity needed to serve this growth has required both significant capital investment and operational AI investment to manage the influx of new patients at existing facilities.

blocks.heading: Telehealth infrastructure post-COVID
paragraphs: Charlotte's healthcare systems invested heavily in telehealth infrastructure during and after COVID-19 — and the telehealth analytics infrastructure built in that investment created the data foundation for subsequent healthcare AI programs. Teladoc's Charlotte operations have further elevated the region's digital health analytics capability.
